the_tree_moved_while_this_was_measured.the_finding: This battery ran across TWO different demo-api source trees. Between 09:21 and 09:26 local time another lead landed the work that resolves blocker 1 (mainline.defeater_option): two brand-new modules (defeaters.py, retry.py) appeared and gate_run.py and transitions.py were rewritten. demo_world.sql was rewritten at 09:19:29 and test_defeaters.py appeared at 09:33:33, taking the demo-api collection from 528 to 556. NEITHER test_transitions.py NOR test_gate_run.py NOR scripts/proof/gate_refusal.py moved at all - their sha256 are recorded below - so the module under study and the seeder that builds its scratch database are byte-identical across every run in this file.
the_tree_moved_while_this_was_measured.why_it_is_recorded_rather_than_smoothed: A single stability number taken across a moving tree would be a fiction. It is also the load-bearing control: the nine node ids that turn red from 09:24 onward do so in EVERY run after that instant regardless of scope, order, database or concurrency, and in NO run before it. A failure that is present in every run of a world and absent from every run of the other is deterministic, and a deterministic failure is not an unstable one.
